announcements.headline: Genel Energy PLC: STATEMENT REGARDING SATISFACTION OF REGULATORY CONDITIONS AND EXPECTED SCHEME TIMETABLE
announcements.insight: Following the September offer statement, this update confirms regulatory conditions are met, advancing the scheme timetable for the transaction.

announcements.headline: Genel Energy PLC: Successful tap issue of bonds
announcements.insight: Following the September contemplation, Genel Energy executed a bond tap issue. This capital raise follows recent M&A activity involving Capricorn and DNO.

announcements.headline: Genel Energy PLC: Contemplated tap issue of existing bond
announcements.insight: Genel Energy PLC contemplates a bond tap issue following its response to DNO ASA. This capital action follows the failed offer for Capricorn Energy.

announcements.headline: Genel Energy PLC: Response to Rule 2.8 announcement from DNO ASA
announcements.insight: Genel Energy confirms no intention to make an offer for Capricorn Energy following its earlier statement regarding the potential bid. This clarifies the status of the proposed transaction.

announcements.headline: Disclosure Table
No Intention to Make an Offer for Genel Energy plc
announcements.insight: Genel Energy confirms no intention to make an offer for itself. This follows earlier statements regarding offers in August and September 2026.

announcements.headline: Genel Energy PLC: Statement regarding offer for Capricorn Energy plc (“Capricorn”)
announcements.insight: Genel Energy PLC is responding to an offer for Capricorn Energy plc. This follows earlier statements regarding a proposed transfer and DNO ASA announcements in August 2026.

announcements.headline: Genel Energy PLC: Notification of Proposed Transfer from the Equity Shares (Transition) Category to the Equity Shares (Commercial Companies) Category
announcements.insight: Genel Energy PLC is proceeding with a scheme of arrangement following the July publication and August offer response. This transfer marks a critical step in the takeover process initiated by DNO ASA.

Genel Energy PLC: Operational Update
announcements.insight: Following the offer announcement in August, this operational update likely relates to the ongoing DNO ASA bid process. Shareholders should monitor for further developments regarding the potential change of control.

announcements.headline: Disclosure Table
Genel Energy PLC: Response to announcement made by DNO ASA
announcements.insight: Genel Energy PLC responds to DNO ASA's offer following the July scheme document. This marks a critical stage in the potential takeover process for shareholders.

announcements.headline: Disclosure Table
Statement regarding offer for Genel Energy plc
announcements.insight: Genel Energy follows its July recommended acquisition offer with this statement, preceding the August court sanction required to finalize the deal.

announcements.headline: Genel Energy PLC: Unaudited results for the period ended 30 June 2026
announcements.insight: Genel Energy PLC has recommended a cash acquisition of Capricorn Energy plc. This follows earlier bond issues and scheme documentation, indicating progress toward completing the transaction.

announcements.headline: Genel Energy PLC: PUBLICATION AND POSTING OF SCHEME DOCUMENT
announcements.insight: Following the July recommended cash acquisition announcement, this scheme document advances the Capricorn Energy merger process toward shareholder approval.
